FULL_REFERENCE_LIST.algorithmic_complexity: O(n log n) deterministic key ordering; O(n) exchange planning

PULL_SELECTED.algorithmic_complexity: O(k log k) selected-key ordering and O(k) lookup

RECEIVER_KNOWN_IDS.algorithmic_complexity: O(n + m) exact set membership after deterministic ordering

RECONCILE_AND_PULL.algorithmic_complexity: O(n log n + k log k) exact ordered reconciliation and pull

SORTED_IDS.algorithmic_complexity: O(n log n) deterministic key ordering

encoding_model.diagnostic_note: duplicate_bytes and irrelevant_bytes are subsets of logical_id_bytes/reference_bytes, not additional total fields

pre_registered_threshold.kill_defer: no >= 25% reduction in any size >= 100 workload
pre_registered_threshold.success: >= 50% reduction in one size >= 100 sparse-interest workload
